comment: Which apps import each lib in PRODUCTION code (apps/<app>/src/**/*.ts, not *.spec.ts; comments stripped). Phase 1 of the shared-libraries plan (2026-10-06): Phase 2 makes Jenkins rebuild an app when a lib it consumes changes. Kept honest by tools/ci/guards/lib-consumers.spec.ts, which recomputes this from the sources and fails on any difference; on a mismatch its diff is the JSON to paste here. alpha-queue and mipl-queue are dead (only commented-out imports remain).
